prompt: On the Cart screen, the item count and total in the header re-render on every keystroke in the order notes box, even though the cart contents don't change. Why?

truth.summary: CartSummary's store selector returns a new { count, total } object on every call, so the store's Object.is check reports a change on every store update, including notes edits.

referenceAnswer.cause: The useCartStore selector returns a new object literal each call, so the Object.is equality check fails on every store update, including notes changes.

decoyAnswers.cause: The selector subscribes to the entire store state, so every store update re-renders the summary.

referenceFix.replace:
const count = useCartStore((state) => state.items.length)
  const total = useCartStore((state) => state.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0))
